project.title: PACT — Procurement Audit & Counterfactual Triage
project.short_description: Enterprise procurement discrepancy triage system combining deterministic 3-way reconciliation on IBM Db2, what-if counterfactual scenario simulation, and grounded LangChain evidence investigation with an immutable audit trail.

features_used: Relational Schema Design (13 tables: 8 procurement source tables + 5 audit/case tables)
CTE Pre-aggregated 3-Way Matching (PO Lines, Receipts, Invoices)
Counterfactual Simulation Ledger (SCENARIO_RUNS without source mutation)
